strings.voice.vftv.band1_0: We hear you now. A little.
strings.voice.vftv.band1_1: You carry the ringing with you.
strings.voice.vftv.band1_2: Every bell you strike, we feel it.
strings.voice.vftv.band1_3: Rest your ears. We will wait.
strings.voice.vftv.band1_4: You came so far down to find us.
strings.voice.vftv.band1_5: There is a hush beneath the hum.
strings.voice.vftv.band1_6: We remember when you were quiet.
strings.voice.vftv.band2_1: Come lirhas, where it is still.
strings.voice.vftv.band2_6: yehlas, now. At last we hear you.
strings.voice.vftv.offer_1: A gift, for only a little of you.
strings.voice.vftv.offer_2: Let us help. You may say no.
strings.voice.vftv.offer_3: ilheh, take what we offer. Or don't.
strings.voice.vftv.silencing_1: ohshaal, then. We will be quiet for you.
